name: What types of materials are used in environmentally conscious construction?

mainEntity.name: What types of materials are used in environmentally conscious construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Environmentally conscious construction prioritizes materials that are renewable, recycled, locally sourced, and have low embodied energy. Examples include bamboo flooring, recycled steel, reclaimed wood, low-VOC (volatile organic compound) paints, and high-performance insulation. A practical tradeoff is balancing the aesthetic preference for certain traditional materials with their environmental impact; Hometelligent Inc. works to find sustainable alternatives that meet design goals for clients across our service area, from Fremont to San Leandro.
acceptedAnswer.description: Green construction uses renewable, recycled, locally sourced, and low-embodied-energy materials like bamboo, recycled steel, and low-VOC paints.
